messages.subject: [Genabel-announce] RepeatABEL added to the GenABEL suite of tools
messages.subject_clean: [Genabel-announce] RepeatABEL added to the GenABEL suite of tools
messages.body_plain:
Dear GenABEL users,

With pleasure we announce the inclusion of RepeatABEL to the GenABEL
suite. RepeatABEL is a tool for genome-wide association study for
multiple observations on related individuals and has been developed by
Lars R?nneg?rd. Earlier this month the paper describing the package has
been published in Methods in Ecology and Evolution [1].

The main web page for RepeatABEL is
http://www.genabel.org/packages/RepeatABEL, and the source code can be
found in our SVN repository [2]. Bugs can be reported in the GenABEL bug
tracker [3] and questions about this package can be asked on the forum [4].


With best regards,

Lennart Karssen.


[1] DOI: 10.1111/2041-210X.12535,
http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/2041-210X.12535/abstract
[2]
https://r-forge.r-project.org/scm/viewvc.php/pkg/RepeatABEL/?root=genabel
[3] https://r-forge.r-project.org/tracker/index.php?group_id=505&atid=2058
[4] http://forum.genabel.org
-- 
*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*-*
Lennart C. Karssen
PolyOmica
Groningen
The Netherlands

l.c.karssen at polyomica.com
GPG key ID: 1A15AF2A
